kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Latin īnsula maior (“larger island”).
g: Mallorca, Majorca (an island in the Mediterranean; largest of the Balearic Islands)
Palma, Palma de Mallorca (a city and port, the capital of the Balearic Islands, Spain, on the island of Mallorca; in full, Palma de Mallorca)
